about: Every live verdict behind the section "Oct 11: Claude Haiku 5.5 as the fallback" of eval/judge/RESULTS.md: the fallback tier alone (JUDGE_EVAL_TIERS=fallback), on Claude Haiku 5.5 at three thinking settings and on Claude Haiku 4.5 as it ships, same prompt and hour.
